headline: Post-match friendly analysis reveals Chelsea team spent 90 minutes debating Mumbai street food superiority
body:
Tactical analysts were left baffled today after reviewing audio logs from the Chelsea versus Real Sociedad friendly, which confirmed that the London side’s midfield spent the entire second half arguing over whether Vada Pav or Misal Pav holds the title of Mumbai’s ultimate comfort food. The debate reportedly escalated during a corner kick sequence, leading to a defensive lapse that allowed for a late goal.

“The team had a perfectly executed formation until the 60th minute when the right winger insisted that the crunch factor of a Vada Pav is structurally superior to the broth-heavy profile of a Misal,” said team communications officer Brian Pringle. “Our captain had to intervene, but he unfortunately landed on the controversial opinion that both are inferior to a properly seasoned Dabeli, which effectively killed the team’s morale for the remainder of the match.”

Real Sociedad players confirmed that they were largely oblivious to the tactical shift, assuming the intense shouting and frantic gesturing from the Chelsea players were elaborate instructions regarding their defensive press. The club has announced that the next training session will be replaced by a blind taste test to settle the matter once and for all.
caption: Forget the 3-1 scoreline, the real drama was in the canteen debate. Does a Vada Pav reign supreme or is Misal the true king of comfort? The dressing room is officially split. #Chelsea #Football #MumbaiStreetFood #SportsNews (satire)
